title: notify
summary: Notify listeners that a handle-object event is occurring.

gpu_support.notes: Event dispatch operates on host object metadata and does not inspect or gather numeric payloads.

description: `notify(H, EventName)` notifies listeners registered for the named event on a handle object. An optional event-data object is passed to listener callbacks.
behaviors: The documented target is a handle object and the event name is case-sensitive text defined by its class.
The documented optional data argument is an `event.EventData` subclass object. Application integer fields nested inside that object remain ordinary exact object payloads.
Integer scalars, arrays, and resident numeric handles have no direct target, event-name, data-control, output-class, or backend role; `notify` is therefore explicitly integer-inapplicable.
RunMat's current event subsystem retains broader callback-argument and status-return conveniences as general compatibility work; they are not treated as MATLAB integer forms.
